newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon has $36.4 mln BoP surplus in September.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon has $36.4 mln BoP surplus in September.

text.p: Lebanon had a $36.4 million balance of payments surplus in September, $68.7 million down on August, the Bank of Lebanon Governor Riad Salameh said in remarks published on Friday.
This brought the year to date surplus up to $322 million compared to a $170.2 million deficit for the same period a year earlier, he added.
"We expect that Lebanon will have a balance of payments surplus between $500 million and $600 million at the end of 1996," Salameh told the Beirut French-speaking magazine Le Commerce Du Levant.
